title: bogota-devnet-2
announcements: bogota-devnet-2 launch is **TBD**. It targeted the week of 2026-10-26, before Devcon, with geth, nethermind and ethrex at genesis ([ACDE #248](https://forkcast.org/calls/acde/248/?summary=notes)). The tests are out and nethermind, ethrex and reth are ready; waiting on geth and the devnet config.

**Scope.** Last EL-only frames devnet: the [bogota-devnet-1](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-1) EIPs at their latest spec, plus EIP-8298, EIP-8151, EIP-4758 and EIP-8253. The EL activates **Bogota** at the Heze fork epoch while the CL stays on Gloas (`FRAMES_ENABLED=true`). The first devnet after Devcon is the combined `hegota-devnet-0` (FOCIL + frames).

Frame txs are **not compatible with devnet-1**: new `fees` field ([PR-12414](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12414)), the sig hash commits to signature lengths ([PR-12502](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12502)), and `EVENTDATACOPY` moves to `0xB7` ([PR-12530](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12530)).

eips.title: Frame Transaction: one `max_fee` budget for execution, state and blob gas ([PR-12414](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12414)), `GASPRICE` under it ([PR-12569](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12569)), signature lengths in the sig hash ([PR-12502](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12502))

Keyed Nonces: an empty key set selects the account nonce, key `0` is ordinary, `MAX_NONCE_SEQ` marks single-use keys ([PR-12511](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12511), [PR-12534](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12534))

Transaction Assertions: `TXDIFF` removed, `EVENTDATACOPY` → `0xB7` ([PR-12530](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12530)); keyed senders left out of `nonces_changed` ([PR-12554](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12554)); `TXTRACE` gas pre-charge uses 8141's `max_cost` ([PR-12576](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12576)); `POST_TX` renamed `ASSERT`
Bump nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts
